name: traffic-sansim-web
description: Web front end of traffic-sansim: map, South Tyrol geodata import, scenarios; the acoustics run in the Rust core compiled to WebAssembly.

scripts.wasm: cargo build --release --manifest-path ../core/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir src/wasm ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/sansim.wasm
scripts.build: npm run wasm && tsc -b && vite build
